responsibility: This file defines the synthetic GNU GIMPLE language front-end hooks that let LTO operate inside GCC as if it were a language front end. It supplies the LTO lang_hooks instance, registers LTO-specific dump files, initializes language tree structures and builtin/common type nodes used when reading streamed IL, and provides the machine-independent attribute tables and handlers that GIMPLE-level declarations may carry, making this the language integration layer between generic GCC front-end machinery and the LTO reader/writer/object-section callbacks.
